title: Range
description: Slider with a live value display and min/max bound labels. input[type="range"] IS this behavior, so there is no attribute to add.

showValue.description: Show the current value above the slider

showLabels.description: Show the min and max bounds below the slider

valuePrefix.description: Text before the value, such as a currency symbol

valueSuffix.description: Text after the value, such as a unit

nativeProperties.description: min, max, step, value, name and disabled are the element's own HTML attributes. The behavior reads min and max for the bound labels but does not define them.

--x-range-gap.description: Gap between the slider, its value and its labels

accessibility.note: The value display is an <output>, so a change is announced without the author wiring aria-live.

setup: <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" showValue showLabels>
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" showValue valueSuffix="%">
<input type="range" min="10" max="1000" value="250" showValue showLabels valuePrefix="$">

matrix.description: Each boolean is exercised in all four author states — absent, bare, "true" and "false" — because "false" used to switch the display ON (#1140).

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: The generated version named these show-value, show-labels, value-prefix and value-suffix, because the generator reads attribute names out of getAttribute/hasAttribute calls and range.js spelled them with dashes. #1140 converted the code to readFlag/readAttr and the names to camelCase (#1125). The generator never overwrites an existing schema, so this hand-expansion stands.
